Mr. Prime Ministe Keir Starmer! this is the regime whose anniversary you celebrated. 
More than 20 plots. In the UK alone. Europe is no longer a safe place it's a hunting ground.
What did he do to stop the Islamic republic? 
Listen.👇
@10DowningStreet

Video

Disturbing revelation by New York Times on IRGC attempt to carry out assassinations on US soil. 
Before the current war,
IRGC's hit list included president Trump AND Iranian dissident Masih Alinejad.
Transnational repression was already operational.
nytimes.com/2026/05/16/world…

These two Iranian women were both shot in the eyes by the Islamic Republic for one simple “crime”: demanding freedom in the streets and refusing to hide their beautiful hair.

With the help of some German organization, we managed to help smuggle them out of Iran. Now they live in Germany.

Recently, I met Farideh first time, the woman in white, who lost both of her eyes after regime forces shot her in the face.

She told me she still believes she will see again.

I asked her softly, “Really?”

S

Six years ago, I called out European leaders for their hypocrisy toward the Islamic Republic. They literally banned me from the European Parliament. what have they achieved all these years?

Do you know how many people on European soil have been targeted by assassination plots? How many have been kidnapped? How many have been killed? 

This year, at Copenhagen Democracy Summit I said it to their faces:

Because of your inaction, Europe is no longer a safe place. It is a hunting ground for dictat

بسیاری از مردم ایران از اوباما متنفر شدند به خاطر سازش با آخوندها و جدا کردن موضوع حقوق بشر از مذاکرات هسته‌ای، ترامپ همین اشتباه را تکرار کند مردم از او هم بیزار خواهند شد. تعارف ندارم، حرف‌هایم را صریح و بی‌پرده در تلویزیون فاکس نیوز گفتم:
در حالی که اروپا و آمریکا در حال تیکه پاره کردن همدیگر هستند رهبران دیکتاتوری در ایران و روسیه و چین مشغول همکاری با هم و‌لذت بردن از این جنگ کشورهای دموکراتیک با یکدیگر هستند، نتیجه؟ اعدام و‌ قتل مردم بی‌پناه در ایران. گفتگوی کامل را بشنوید


Masih Alinejad

The Mullahs, Putin, and the Chinese Communist Party don’t need to attack the West anymore. They just turn on the TV and watch America and Europe tear each other apart for free.

And while politicians debate slogans, real people get executed, blinded, imprisoned, and silenced.

For years, Western politicians separated human rights from nuclear deals and business interests. The result? Stronger dictators. Weaker democracies.

Watch my interview with @marthamaccallum

Video

The last person whose name I mentioned in this interview was Mohammad Abbasi. And today, the Islamic Republic hanged him.

I cannot stop thinking about his daughter.

Before killing Mohammad, the regime arrested his daughter and sentenced her to 25 years in prison. Imagine being a father in a prison cell, knowing your child is suffering because of you. Knowing the people interrogating you are using your daughter’s life to break your spirit.

They tortured him. Threatened him through his own chil

This is the moment I met one of my heroes for the first time.
For years, we wrote about brave Iranian protesters from far away. We spoke about a young woman who lost both eyes after the Islamic Republic shot her for demanding freedom in the streets of Iran. Then one day, I finally held her in my arms.
Her name is Farideh. A young Kurdish woman from Sanandaj. Blinded by a regime terrified of free women.
Too many people reduce these stories to geopolitics and partisan arguments. But all of that di

ما به همراه تیم‌مان در تلاش هستیم تا نگرانی‌های مربوط به وضعیت مهاجران قانونی و دانشجویان ایرانی را با دولت آمریکا در میان بگذاریم؛ بسیاری از این دانشجویان هیچ وابستگی‌ای به جمهوری اسلامی ندارند و خود قربانی این رژیم بوده‌اند و حق‌شان نیست که دوباره زخمی شوند.

برای اینکه بتوانیم تصویر دقیق‌تر و واقعی‌تری از این شرایط ارائه دهیم، شنیدن تجربه‌ها و دغدغه‌های شما برای ما بسیار مهم است. اگر در چنین شرایطی هستید، لطفاً تجربه و اطلاعات خود را با ما در میان بگذارید.

به شماره تلگرام درج‌شده در تصویر پی

I read the names of freedom fighters killed by the regime in Iran on every international media, because regime wants to erase them, their faces, their voices, their names.
We should not let them kill protesters twice: first by execution, then by silence.

Video

It was an honor to inviting two Iranian heroes, to the stage at the Copenhagen Democracy Summit, where they spoke directly to European leaders.

Farideh lost both eyes after being shot by the Islamic Republic. Kosar was blinded in one eye and recently attacked by some Western activists in Berlin for calling the Islamic Republic and its proxies terrorists.
These women can no longer fully see the world. But they see tyranny more clearly than many in the West. 
Listen to them. Share their message w

“He fired as if swatting a fly.”

Farideh says the last image burned into her mind was the face of the man who shot her in the eyes. 
Not in war. Not on a battlefield. On a street in Sanandaj.
Farideh Salavatipour lost both eyes because a regime looked at a woman demanding freedom, and chose to blind her. Deliberately. Methodically. Without remorse.
But what terrifies dictatorships most is not anger. It is hope.
Farideh still dreams of seeing colors again. Seeing her city again. Watching freedom
